newsitem.title: USA: Stormedia cites Maxtor for lower Q3 sales.
newsitem.headline: Stormedia cites Maxtor for lower Q3 sales.

text.p: StorMedia Inc said a decline in third quarter sales was principally due to Maxtor Corp's failure to purchase the volume committed under a volume purchase contract which was cancelled in September.

This month, StorMedia signed a letter of intent to sell computer disk drive components to an unidentified disk drive maker, which would replace half the revenue StorMedia lost when Maxtor, a unit of Hyundai Electronics of America, cancelled its contract.
StorMedia reported a third quarter loss of $0.52 a share on revenues of $41.6 million.
This compares to a profit of $0.40 per share on sales of $46.0 million a year ago.

"In an effort to replace the volume under contract with Maxtor, the company accelerated qualification and production of new products, which has resulted in significantly lower yields and gross margins," said StorMedia, which has filed a lawsuit against Maxtor.
